description: This file defines a test suite class for running native C/C++ Android tests, including methods for discovering test sources, filtering binaries, executing tests on host and device, and handling test results.

classes.name: NativeTestSuite
classes.description: A class for running native Android C/C++ tests on device and host.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the native test suite, running tests on host and device, and handling output and cleanup.

methods.name: _CollectTestSources
methods.description: Collects test source files matching specific patterns from directory tree.

methods.name: _FilterOutMissing
methods.description: Filters out test sources that do not have corresponding built binaries.

methods.name: _FindFileRecursively
methods.description: Recursively searches for a file matching a name in a directory tree.

methods.name: _RunHostCommand
methods.description: Runs a command on the host system, optionally under valgrind, and returns the exit code.
